data.name: Hamdanah
data.gender_notes: Hamdanah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman who is always praising Allah and expressing her gratitude. In the Quran, Hamdanah is mentioned as one of the names of Maryam, the mother of Prophet Isa (Jesus) (Quran 3:45). The name Hamdanah carries the meaning “Praiser, Gracious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hamdanah usually hope their child will grow to embody praiser, gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes a woman who is always in the state of dhikr (remembrance of Allah)
data.etymology: Hamdanah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Praiser, Gracious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hamdanah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
